decisions.question: Input/output layout
decisions.answer: Single editor, format in place with undo

decisions.answer: scroll + cancel only

decisions.question: Undo depth for huge documents
decisions.answer: 100 steps normal; last 3 tool ops for >10MB

decisions.answer: Yes in M-1 (cache-only service worker, ADR-0012)

decisions.question: Spec clarifications O-1..O-3
decisions.answer: Accept all three

decisions.question: Run spikes now in parallel with design
decisions.answer: Yes

decisions.question: D1 component designs

decisions.question: Tree row actions placement

decisions.question: WebKit service worker vs NFR-01
decisions.answer: Amend NFR-01: browser's own install/update fetches of the tool's own files allowed

decisions.question: Syntax colouring threshold
decisions.answer: Keep 10 MB; accept lag 2-10 MB (NFR-02 exception)

decisions.question: F-007 download-blocked requirement
decisions.answer: Deprecate F-007.R5/AC6; Copy fallback covers it

decisions.question: NFR-04 memory wording
decisions.answer: 1.5 GB measured after GC on Chromium; best effort on WebKit/Gecko

decisions.question: WebKit limits at 100 MB
decisions.answer: Accept: scroll stutter and copy >120 MB fallback as known limits; revisit M-3

decisions.answer: Owner's own work; reuse freely
